The first frame's focus gutter is on Current directory. Down selects payments-platform, Right expands it, and Down selects the jk-7f3a row. The row paints the id as 7f3a via trim_start_matches. Enter calls activate, then reconnect. InstanceStatus::Running calls Go::Attach with pane None. Go::Attach in src/bin/jackin/app.rs requires Running, sets attached_by to this terminal, opens CapsuleScreen, and sets Attached to payments-platform · tabs and panes restored. The identity bar shows payments-platform › the-architect. The daemon in fixtures.rs is the booted Claude pane, the Codex split, and the shell, focused on pane 1, plus the docs tab. Ctrl+B d calls detach in src/bin/jackin/screens/capsule.rs and Go::Detach, which returns to the manager, select_instance leaves 7f3a selected, and the status is Detached · payments-platform keeps running. The process stays there. You were in the Construct from src/bin/jackin/rain.rs stays absent. --frame is not used.
